fusions.name: Closing Jaws
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Closes in for 22 damage, leaving it [Stalled] for 3 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shrinking Ring
fusions.desc: You swim a closing circle, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bait Ball
fusions.desc: Creates a pull zone 5 tiles across ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bar by Bar
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
